task: User-proposed RevIN multi-scale time-frequency dual encoder cross-attention sparse MoE joint quantile forecasting plus fine tuning current best ensemble

fields.W: production_power_util is a proxy for workload-related power, not CPU/GPU compute utilization
fields.R: No dynamic resource-state measurements; masks/availability are quality metadata only
fields.C: Known time/calendar and cell ID; no invented weather or future load

development_targets: May15-22; first four choose family member, later four choose blend/calibration using conservative one-standard-error rule
new_model_configs: fusion width16/32; no cross-attention; no frequency; dense MoE; checkpoints4/10/20 epochs
finetune_configs: TimesFM3 head-only with lr3e-6 or1e-5, last transformer plus head lr3e-7, checkpoints50/150/300; teacher anchor and masked pinball/point loss
calibration: Shared strongly regularized residual calibrator trained on earlier causal predictions; no test-based fitting
inference_policy: All inputs precede forecast origin; production labels masked when unreliable; capacity [0,1], production-proxy quantiles <= total corresponding quantiles
primary_objective: Macro domain WAPE; also peak MAPE, daily WAPE, quantile coverage/width and domain/cell breakdown
stop_rule: Fixed registered grid, never iterate on TEST scores within this round; select alpha0 if improvement is within paired-cell one standard error
claimed_significance: Only exploratory descriptive confidence intervals; no guarantee of large gain or absence of selection overfitting
